power.name: Power
power.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit.
power.behindText: Each hit that lands builds a short damage bonus.
power.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life.

poison.name: Poison
poison.about: The word of venom. A slow death.
poison.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons. Poison stacks.

frost.name: Frost
frost.behindText: Passes through, hits softer, leaves ice that slows.
frost.monsterText: Deals frost damage and slows you.

fire.name: Flame
fire.frontText: Fire damage. Explodes and sets enemies burning.
fire.behindText: Passes through, hits softer, leaves burning ground.
fire.monsterText: Deals fire damage and sets you burning.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.frontText: Lightning damage. Arcs to nearby enemies.
lightning.behindText: Passes through, hits softer, leaves a storm that strikes.
lightning.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you.

swift.name: Swift
swift.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed.

heavy.name: Heavy
heavy.about: The word of weight. Slow, and crushing.
heavy.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns.
heavy.behindText: Leaves cracked ground that staggers enemies.

twin.name: Twin
twin.about: The word of doubling. Two of a thing, each the weaker for it.
twin.frontText: Strikes, fires or bursts twice, each time weaker.
twin.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later, weaker.

leech.name: Leech
leech.about: The word of hunger. It takes life from what it touches.
leech.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit.
leech.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs.

volatile.name: Volatile
volatile.about: The word of ruin. Things burst.
volatile.behindText: Leaves a rune that detonates a moment later.

precise.name: Precise
precise.about: The word of the exact. Narrow, and deadly.
precise.behindText: Marks an enemy: your next hit on it is a certain critical.
precise.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour.

frenzied.name: Frenzied
frenzied.about: The word of rage. Faster, and faster.
frenzied.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times.
frenzied.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt.

guarding.name: Guarding
guarding.about: The word of the shield. It keeps you.
guarding.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield.
guarding.behindText: Leaves a ward circle: you take less damage inside it.
guarding.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage.

lasting.name: Lasting
lasting.about: The word of the long hour. What it makes, stays.
lasting.frontText: Everything it makes and gives lasts half again as long.
lasting.behindText: Everything it makes and gives lasts half again as long.
lasting.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you.

fleeting.name: Fleeting
fleeting.about: The word of the moment. All of it, sooner.
fleeting.frontText: Everything it makes and gives is a third shorter, and does as much in that time.
fleeting.behindText: Everything it makes and gives is a third shorter, and does as much in that time.
fleeting.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster.

vast.name: Vast
vast.about: The word of the wide. Broad, and lighter.
vast.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage.
vast.behindText: Each hit splashes onto the enemies near what it hits.

strike.name: Strike
strike.desc: Hit one enemy in front of you.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: Hold to spin: you cut everything around you again and again, and pass through enemies.

leap.name: Lunge
leap.desc: Dive at a spot, your sword out before you. Nothing can hit you as you go, and the point strikes where you land.
